notes: System-versioned temporal proc (tranche 2). Two cursors: SupplierCategories (excludes @InitialLoadDate 2013-01-01) then Suppliers (INCLUDES the initial load). Each change-point snapshots the joins with FOR SYSTEM_TIME AS OF @ValidFrom; the projected [Valid From]/[Valid To] are the SUPPLIER row's own period, so rows can share a [Valid From] -- ORDER BY [Valid From] is not a total order, hence ordered=false (canonicaliser value-sort keeps golden stable). Seed change-points for supplier 1: SupplierCategories current 2020-07-01 (archive 2013-01-01), Suppliers current 2021-03-01 postal 30301 (archive 2013-01-01 postal 30300). PrimaryContactPersonID=4 (Dan Supplier), SupplierReference SUP-001, PaymentDays 30. resultset is transcribed verbatim from the proc's #SupplierChanges CREATE TABLE -- describe cannot introspect it (error 11526); INSERT..EXEC fails loudly if it drifts.

cases.name: all-changes
cases.why: Window opens before the initial load (2012-01-01), so both cursors fire: SupplierCategories at 2020-07-01, Suppliers at 2013-01-01 (initial load, included) and 2021-03-01. Exercises both cursors and the initial-load inclusion on the supplier arm.

cases.name: initial-load-excluded
cases.why: @LastCutoff is EXACTLY 2013-01-01; the supplier cursor's strict `> @LastCutoff` drops the 2013-01-01 row -> one fewer row than all-changes. Pins the exclusive lower bound.

cases.name: category-only
cases.why: Narrow window (2020-06-15, 2020-07-15] catches only the SupplierCategories change at 2020-07-01. Isolates the category cursor.

cases.name: supplier-only
cases.why: Narrow window (2021-02-15, 2021-03-15] catches only the Suppliers change at 2021-03-01 (postal 30300 -> 30301). Isolates the supplier cursor's non-initial-load arm.

cases.name: empty-window
cases.why: Window (2015-01-01, 2016-01-01] contains no change-point -> empty result.
